text: The Axiom of Infinity in ZFC asserts the existence of a set containing:
choices: ∅ and for each x, the set x∪{x}
all natural numbers as a proper class
explanation: Infinity: ∃S: ∅∈S ∧ ∀x∈S: x∪{x}∈S. This gives a set containing 0,1,2,… (the von Neumann naturals) and so guarantees infinite sets exist.
